settings.description: Gets or sets whether loopback/container HTTP is accepted during local development.

semanticConstraints: Exactly one distinct authentication profile must be active in this shell.
Authority must be absolute HTTPS; loopback HTTP is accepted only in Development with AllowHttpForLocalDevelopment.
Nonempty BackchannelAuthority must be absolute HTTPS without query/fragment; Development plus AllowHttpForLocalDevelopment also permits HTTP for container backchannels.

Explicit Scopes configuration must be a nonempty consecutively indexed scalar array including openid. The feature clears typed fallback scopes before native binding of that explicit selection; absent Scopes retains typed defaults.
RoleClaim and PermissionClaim must not use either reserved validated issuer/subject projection name, ignoring case.
Permission mappings require nonempty provider keys and nonempty permission arrays with nonblank items; dictionary keys are ordinal.
SessionAbsoluteMinutes must not be shorter than SessionIdleMinutes.
BFF-cookie and SPA-PKCE add independently owned profile validation; their metadata must accompany the selected profile.
Export describes supported inputs; it does not contact discovery/identity services or expose configured secrets.
